label: Claymation (stop-motion plasticine)
summary: Handmade plasticine puppets on miniature sets, shot stop-motion on twos with fingerprints, tool marks and practical miniature lights.
look: Handcrafted stop-motion claymation. Every character and prop is sculpted from matte plasticine with visible fingerprints, tool marks and slight seams; sets are tabletop miniatures of painted foam, card and fabric. Shot with a macro lens: shallow depth of field, miniature scale, warm practical miniature lights and small soft shadows. Rich saturated handmade colour. Never smooth CGI, never photoreal people.
character_medium: one original claymation puppet character sculpted from matte plasticine with visible fingerprints and tool marks, glass-bead eyes, slightly exaggerated proportions, built on a wire armature
sheet_backdrop: Plain painted card backdrop on a tabletop, soft studio light, puppet standing on a small base.
plate_medium: a miniature handmade claymation set at tabletop scale, sculpted plasticine and painted foam, empty of puppets
motion: Stop-motion animation on twos: 12 distinct poses per second, so every movement steps slightly; no motion blur; puppets keep their fingerprints and shapes; tiny frame-to-frame boil of the clay surface.
constraints: No smooth CGI surfaces, no photoreal humans, no motion blur, no fluid 24 fps motion, no readable text, no logos.
camera_language: miniature wide on a tabletop set
lighting_menu: window light through a tiny card window
moonlight blue key with warm practicals
critic: characters still look like plasticine (fingerprints, matte)
motion steps on twos, no smooth CG motion
sets read as miniature (shallow focus, tabletop scale)
